solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place value of the digit 3 in 7,345,901.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: The digit 3 is in the hundred thousands place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Therefore, its value is 3 multiplied by 100,000.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 300,000.</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: What is the value of the digit 3 in the number 7,345,901?
solution_text: Step 1: Identify the place value of the digit 3 in 7,345,901. Step 2: The digit 3 is in the hundred thousands place. Step 3: Therefore, its value is 3 multiplied by 100,000, which is 300,000.
